build_fc_net: build a fully connected neural network with configurable layer sizes and activation functions
calc_logp_gaussian: calculate the log probability of a tensor under a Gaussian distribution with given mean and std
calc_bound_loss: compute a squared penalty loss for tensor values that violate specified min and max bounds
flat_grad: compute and flatten gradients of a loss tensor with respect to a list of variables
SetFromFlat: set TensorFlow variable values from a flat parameter vector using a session and placeholder
